definitions.short: to bake (round cakes on the hearth)
definitions.full: H5746. ug [ עוּג ] verb denominative bake (a cake; literally make a cake of ); — Qal Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix 3 feminine singular תְּעֻגֶנָֿה (so Baer Ginsb, > van d. H. תְּעֻגֶּנּה ) thou shalt bake it (on form see Kö i. 496 f. Ges § 58k ) Ezek 4:12 .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; properly, to gyrate; but used only as a denominative from 5692 ,

occurrences.englishText: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
